title: Intent
description: A prompt overlay for one kind of work, at strategy-templates/<strategy>/intents/<id>.yaml. An intent changes what participants are told to look for and what counts as done; it never changes the phase shape, roles, review rules or completion policy — those are the strategy's. Guidance is keyed by step id and appended to that step's prompt under an 'Intent' heading, for template and coordinator-authored prompts alike.

description.description: One or two sentences: which kinds of request this intent is for. Shown to operators and to the supervisor when choosing.

covers.description: Task kinds this intent absorbs, for discovery.

guidance.description: Step id → markdown appended to that step's prompt. Unknown step ids are a load error.
